neighbours.label: the determiner ' any' after have/had/got, asking or stating whether someone has something, as against the same requests worded without a determiner after have
fire: Before we start, do you have any allergies?
Please tell us if you have any special requests.
Has your child had any vaccinations this year?
We never got any reply from the landlord.
Did they have any trouble finding the house?
If you have any spare blankets, bring them along.
The new hires haven't had any training yet.
Has the team got any ideas for the logo?

Please tell us about special requests in advance.
Any child can join the summer program for free.
We are still waiting for the landlord to reply.
Did they find the house without trouble?
Spare blankets are kept in the hall closet.
The new hires start their training next week.
Any idea for the logo is welcome.
